result.summary: The bottom navigation area appears visually broken: its contents are clipped by the bottom edge and an unintended horizontal dark bar overlaps the navigation icons. The rest of the page generally appears intact, with partially visible carousel items likely indicating horizontal scrolling.

issues.description: The bottom navigation bar is cut off by the screen edge. The navigation icons are only partially visible and their labels are missing/clipped, making the persistent navigation difficult to use.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the bottom navigation container height and safe-area inset so the full icons and labels remain inside the viewport on this device size.

issues.description: A thick dark horizontal line overlays the bottom navigation around the search icon, looking like a rendering artifact or incorrectly positioned UI element.
issues.suggestion: Identify and remove or reposition the overlapping element; ensure z-index, absolute positioning, and safe-area calculations do not place it across the navigation bar.
